mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tbl_attempt_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY session_id DESC

SELECT ad.attempt_id, ad.session_id, ad.problem_id, ad.selected_choice_id, sc.choice_text AS selected_choice_text, -- 사용자가 선택한 보기의 텍스트 cc.choice_text AS correct_choice_text, -- 정답 보기의 텍스트 (CASE WHEN ad.selected_choice_id IS NULL THEN NULL -- 선택 안 했으면 NULL WHEN ad.selected_choice_id = cc.choice_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_correct FROM tbl_attempt_details ad LEFT JOIN tbl_problem_choices sc ON ad.selected_choice_id = sc.choice_id -- 사용자가 선택한 보기 가져오기 LEFT JOIN tbl_problem_choices cc ON ad.problem_id = cc.problem_id AND cc.is_correct = 1 -- 정답 가져오기 WHERE ad.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY ad.problem_id, ad.attempt_id;
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(times), 0) FROM tbl_attempt_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
